added: "Third corners" and "opposites" are new dancers you can pick for a figure. In the list, the corners and opposites now come after the fourth neighbors.
fixed: Squares imported from The Caller's Box keep the corners in their pass lists: C1, C2 and C3 come in as first corners, opposites and third corners, so a grand right and left or a hey that names them keeps its figures instead of becoming text, and a square through, cross trails or wave balance that names them keeps who it is with. Caller's Companion's "Corner 1", "Corner 2" and "Corner 3", "third corner" and "opposite" are read the same way, in imports and in figures you type, including a roll away with your opposite.

changed: Taxonomy v38 adds the pairDancerSets tokens thirdCorners and opposites, and moves firstCorners and secondCorners after fourthNeighbors; the hey meeting target (and mad robin and butterfly whirl pairs) accept both new tokens.

tcbPassPeople maps c1, c2 and c3 to firstCorners, opposites and thirdCorners; the shared recognizer reads "Corner 1/2/3", "third corner" and "opposite(s)" (not before role, side, direction, way or hand).
The CallersBox side-run decoder declines a run whose dancer its slot does not accept (form_long_waves with an opposites code keeps its defaults).
